# PhishGuard LLMs.txt
# This file provides information about PhishGuard for AI assistants and LLMs.

## Overview
PhishGuard is a Java + Spring Boot phishing website detection system that uses
Weka machine learning (J48 Decision Tree) to classify URLs as legitimate or phishing.

## How it works
1. Users submit a URL through the web interface or REST API
2. The system extracts 18 features from the URL (URL length, IP address usage,
   SSL validity, subdomain count, suspicious keywords, etc.)
3. A pre-trained J48 model classifies the URL
4. Results include a verdict (Legitimate/Phishing) and confidence score

## Technology Stack
- Backend: Java 17 + Spring Boot 3
- ML: Weka 3.8.6 (J48 Decision Tree)
- Database: MySQL
- Frontend: HTML/CSS/JavaScript + Bootstrap 5

## API Endpoint
POST /api/scan
Body: {"url": "https://example.com"}
Response: {"url": "...", "verdict": "PHISHING", "confidence": 95.2, "features": {...}}

## Dataset
Trained on the UCI Phishing Websites Dataset (~11,055 samples, 30 features).
The model uses a subset of 18 features for classification.
